verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an AI assistant built into the Statsig console that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server lets external AI clients such as Codex, Cursor and Claude Code query Statsig data, which is a separate MCP-server capability, not an in-product assistant. The OpenAI, Azure AI and AI Evals features are for experimenting on the customer's own AI applications, so they are adjacent and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
